name: TokenSpecimen
summary: Draws one design token so its value can be seen, the drawing chosen by what the token is: one component for every kind, not a variant per kind. The values come from the tokens themselves, so the specimen is always current. Not for content: a chart's bar is a StackedBar, a status message is text with a tone.
a11y: Decorative: every specimen but `type`, `font` with text and `ramp` is `aria-hidden`, so the token's name and value must be in nearby text. A ramp is an ordered list whose steps read as their name and value. Motion plays only when `played` changes; `easing` and `duration` not at all with reduced motion, `travel` and `fade` as their role does in that context (travel snaps, a fade still fades).

props.name: kind
props.description: What the token is: `colour` (a swatch), `ramp` (a strip of colour steps), `contrast` (text in one colour on another), `type` (a text style), `font` (a font's shapes, or a line in it), `length` (a bar), `size` (a square), `radius`, `stroke`, `shadow` (a tile), `easing` (its curve and a dot that moves along a track), `duration` (a track that fills), `travel` (a motion role that moves: a dot crossing its track by transform) or `fade` (a motion role that changes a value: a tile whose fill fades to the mark colour). `travel` and `fade` play with the role's own duration, so a reduced-motion subtree shows what that context keeps. `material` (Q73) draws a surface of the material (`token`, its fill; `value`, its backdrop-filter token) over stripes, with text on it. `elevation` (Q78) draws one level of the ladder: a surface (`token`, its fill) on what it sits on (`on`, laid over the canvas, so a scrim dims it), with its shadow (`value`) and its outline (`edge`) when it has them.

props.name: token
props.description: The custom property drawn, e.g. `--space-4`. For `type`, the style's prefix (`--type-heading-1`, read as its `-size`, `-leading` and `-weight`); for `font`, the stack; for `contrast`, the text colour.

props.name: on
props.description: `contrast`: the colour the text sits on. `elevation`: the surface under the level, e.g. `--color-bg-overlay`.

props.name: edge
props.description: `elevation`: the outline colour token, when the level has one, e.g. `--color-border`.

props.name: family
props.description: `type`: the font stack to set the sample in, when the style doesn't set one, e.g. `--font-code`.

props.name: share
props.description: `length`: draw to scale as a share of the room (0 to 100) instead of at the token's own length.

props.name: value
props.description: `easing`: its four control points as written, e.g. `0.2, 0, 0, 1`, to draw its curve. `material`: the backdrop-filter token, e.g. `--material-backdrop`.

props.name: played
props.description: `easing`, `duration`, `travel` and `fade`: the motion has been played, so the dot or fill sits at its end.

props.name: children
props.description: `type`, `font` and `contrast`: the sample text. A `font` without text shows its large Aa.

props.name: ref
props.description: The drawn element, so a reader can measure what it shows (a `colour` swatch's text colour is its canvas).

props.name: value
props.description: The value it holds, as written.
